description: This file defines enums, types, and function prototypes related to binder status and error handling in Android's native code, including error codes, exception types, and AStatus management functions.

methods.name: AStatus_newOk
methods.description: Creates a new AStatus object representing a successful status.

methods.name: AStatus_fromExceptionCode
methods.description: Creates a new AStatus object with a specified exception code.

methods.name: AStatus_fromExceptionCodeWithMessage
methods.description: Creates a new AStatus object with a specified exception code and message.

methods.name: AStatus_fromServiceSpecificError
methods.description: Creates a new AStatus object with a service-specific error code.

methods.name: AStatus_fromServiceSpecificErrorWithMessage
methods.description: Creates a new AStatus object with a service-specific error code and message.

methods.name: AStatus_fromStatus
methods.description: Creates a new AStatus object from a low-level binder_status_t error.

methods.name: AStatus_isOk
methods.description: Checks if the AStatus object represents a successful status.

methods.name: AStatus_getExceptionCode
methods.description: Retrieves the exception code from the AStatus object.

methods.name: AStatus_getServiceSpecificError
methods.description: Retrieves the service-specific error code if applicable.

methods.name: AStatus_getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the low-level binder status code if applicable.

methods.name: AStatus_getDescription
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description for debugging.

methods.name: AStatus_delete
methods.description: Deletes the AStatus object and frees associated memory.
